props.label: Main
props.html:
Interior painting

A clean, low-mess interior repaint

Interior painting is as much about protecting your home as it is about colour. We mask, cover and cut in with care, so you get crisp lines and even walls without paint where it should not be.

We repaint living areas, bedrooms, kitchens, hallways and whole homes across Sydney, working room by room so you can keep living in the house. Walls, ceilings, doors, skirtings and architraves all get the prep they need before we start.

Want a feature wall or a specialty finish? We can take that further with decorative finishes and venetian plaster too.

What we cover

Inside your home, finished properly

Walls and ceilings

Full repaints and colour changes with even coverage and clean cut in lines.

Doors, skirtings and trims

Crisp enamel or low sheen finishes on doors, architraves and skirting boards.

Feature walls

Accent walls and colour, with sample pots so you can approve the look first.

Kitchens and wet areas

Durable, wipeable finishes for kitchens, bathrooms and laundries.

Hallways and stairwells

High traffic areas coated in hard wearing paints that stay looking fresh.

Repairs and patching

Filling holes, cracks and dents, then sanding smooth before painting.

Why it lasts

The prep behind a smooth wall

A wall only looks flawless if what is under the paint is sound. We wash where needed, fill and sand imperfections, spot prime patches and cut in by hand, so the final coats sit flat and even.

We match the sheen to the room, flat and low sheen for walls and ceilings where you want to hide imperfections, and a tougher finish for trims and high traffic areas that need to take a knock.

Our process

How an interior repaint runs

Quote and colours

We look at the rooms, talk through colours and sheens, and quote in writing.

Mask and protect

Floors, furniture and fixtures are covered, edges masked and surfaces prepared.

Prime and paint

Patches are primed, then we cut in and roll the agreed coats.

Detail and clean

Trims finished, masking removed, site cleaned and walked through with you.

props.label: Interior painting questions
props.html:
Good to know

Interior painting questions

Can we stay in the house while you paint?

Yes. We work room by room, keep the site tidy and use low VOC, low odour paints, so most families stay in the home while we paint. We plan the order with you.

Do you paint ceilings and trims as well as walls?

Yes. Walls, ceilings, doors, skirtings and architraves are all part of a full interior repaint, each with the right paint and sheen for the surface.

Can you help choose colours?

We are happy to talk through colours and sheens and can provide sample pots so you can see them on your own walls before we commit.

How long does an interior repaint take?

A single room is often a day or two, while a whole home takes longer. We give you a realistic timeframe in the quote.

Do you do feature walls and specialty finishes?

Yes. Beyond standard interior painting we offer decorative finishes and venetian plaster for feature walls.

props.label: Main
props.html:
Interior painting

A clean, low-mess interior repaint

Interior painting is as much about protecting your home as it is about colour. We mask, cover and cut in with care, so you get crisp lines and even walls without paint where it should not be.

We repaint living areas, bedrooms, kitchens, hallways and whole homes across Sydney, working room by room so you can keep living in the house. Walls, ceilings, doors, skirtings and architraves all get the prep they need before we start.

Want a feature wall or a specialty finish? We can take that further with decorative finishes and venetian plaster too.

What we cover

Inside your home, finished properly

Walls and ceilings

Full repaints and colour changes with even coverage and clean cut in lines.

Doors, skirtings and trims

Crisp enamel or low sheen finishes on doors, architraves and skirting boards.

Feature walls

Accent walls and colour, with sample pots so you can approve the look first.

Kitchens and wet areas

Durable, wipeable finishes for kitchens, bathrooms and laundries.

Hallways and stairwells

High traffic areas coated in hard wearing paints that stay looking fresh.

Repairs and patching

Filling holes, cracks and dents, then sanding smooth before painting.

Why it lasts

The prep behind a smooth wall

A wall only looks flawless if what is under the paint is sound. We wash where needed, fill and sand imperfections, spot prime patches and cut in by hand, so the final coats sit flat and even.

We match the sheen to the room, flat and low sheen for walls and ceilings where you want to hide imperfections, and a tougher finish for trims and high traffic areas that need to take a knock.

Image placeholder Close up of smooth freshly rolled interior wall with clean cut in edge Recommended 3:2 landscape, about 900x600px, WebP
Our process

How an interior repaint runs

Quote and colours

We look at the rooms, talk through colours and sheens, and quote in writing.

Mask and protect

Floors, furniture and fixtures are covered, edges masked and surfaces prepared.

Prime and paint

Patches are primed, then we cut in and roll the agreed coats.

Detail and clean

Trims finished, masking removed, site cleaned and walked through with you.

props.label: Interior painting questions
props.html:
Good to know

Interior painting questions

Can we stay in the house while you paint?

Yes. We work room by room, keep the site tidy and use low VOC, low odour paints, so most families stay in the home while we paint. We plan the order with you.

Do you paint ceilings and trims as well as walls?

Yes. Walls, ceilings, doors, skirtings and architraves are all part of a full interior repaint, each with the right paint and sheen for the surface.

Can you help choose colours?

We are happy to talk through colours and sheens and can provide sample pots so you can see them on your own walls before we commit.

How long does an interior repaint take?

A single room is often a day or two, while a whole home takes longer. We give you a realistic timeframe in the quote.

Do you do feature walls and specialty finishes?

Yes. Beyond standard interior painting we offer decorative finishes and venetian plaster for feature walls.
